facts.business: Lloyds Metals and Energy Limited is an integrated metal and mining company engaged in iron ore mining, pellet production, DRI, and steel manufacturing with logistics infrastructure including slurry pipelines.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Commissioning of key infrastructure such as the Hedri–Konsari slurry pipeline and ramp-up of pellet plant and DRI project in FY 2025-26

auditor.name: M/s. Todarwal & Todarwal LLP, Chartered Accountants

key_risks: Substantial investment in Capital Work-in-Progress (CWIP) with inherent challenges related to accurate recognition, measurement and disclosure
Material financial guarantees exposure totalling Rs 6,757.80 crore as of balance sheet date
Expansion phase execution risks including project delays and cost overruns
